mainText: Hello, Verona! At 7 PM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 67 degrees with overcast skies at Fireman's Park and a waning gibbous moon. The ISS passes overhead tonight, but you won't be able to see it due to the clouds. Expect an overnight low of 62 degrees with rain predicted overnight.

City Hall reminds residents that Hwy M near the future Aldi site will be closed from October 6 through October 9 for road improvements, with detours directed to Old PB and Verona Avenue. Also, remember that early voting for the November election begins soon at City Hall, and trick-or-treat hours are officially set for October 31 from 5 PM to 8 PM.
There is plenty to do, including Hop Haus Trivia happening today, followed by yoga, the Farmer's Market, and trivia at The Bogey Factory all happening tomorrow.
In a noteworthy call from September 21, officers were dispatched to a store on East Verona Avenue where a subject was identified via surveillance and cited for the retail theft of candy.
Today's flavor of the day at Culver's is the delicious Caramel Peanut Buttercup. The store is currently open and will remain open until 10:00 PM tonight.
